rows.why: B's head shows a defined mouth line with small teeth and tusks plus broader shoulder and chest mass; A's teeth are star-shaped spikes floating on the lip and the chest and legs are plainer. / A's head has a clean lip line with a row of tiny teeth and two fangs along the jaw; B's teeth are spiky star shapes stuck on the lower jaw outside any clear mouth line. Bodies are otherwise the same.

A's overlapping smooth scales are clean and the head has a clear mouth line with a row of teeth; B's cracked polygon pattern is noisy and its teeth are a few jagged bits with no clear mouth. / B's overlapping scales and a visible mouth line with a row of teeth read as a reptile; A's cracked-cell skin is faceted and noisy on the head and legs, and its teeth float with no clear mouth edge.

Same silhouette, but B adds segment lines on the back and jointed legs that read as insect plates; A is a smooth blob with plain tube legs. / A's beetle body has fine segment grooves across the shell, which reads as insect; B is a smooth glossy blob with the same spots and horn. A small edge for A.

B's overlapping scales and rounder head read as a clean snake; A's faceted polygon scales look noisy and low-res on the head and neck. Both have the same fangs and eyes. Weak preference. / A's snake has smooth overlapping scales on the head and neck; B's cell-pattern skin looks blocky and faceted on the neck and head, which reads as noise.

Body and horns are identical, but A has a visible toothy mouth line across the head while B's face has no readable mouth at all. / B's head has a visible mouth slit with a row of small teeth; A's head has no readable mouth at all, only a smooth seam under the jaw. Bodies are identical.

B has an actual mouth opening along the muzzle with a row of small teeth behind the fangs; A just has fangs poking out of a dark muzzle with no mouth line. Same body, horns and stripes. / A's demon has a mouth line with small teeth along the lip under the fangs; in B the fangs sit on the dark muzzle with no clear mouth, so they look pasted on.

B's fine smooth scales, lip line and denser spots over body and tail read as a salamander; A's head has blocky square scales and a chunky chin block. / A's salamander has fine overlapping scales and a clear mouth line along the jaw, and its legs are rounded; B's head has blocky rectangular scales and a boxy chin, and its limbs are angular.

B has a clean smile line under the snout and a cleaner jaw; A has a ragged, jagged colour edge on the chin and no defined mouth. Same tusks and spine. / A has a clean smiling mouth line under the muzzle; B has a jagged, dithered edge between the brown and the dark chin, most visible in the front view, and no clear mouth.

B's head has soft overlapping scales and a clear smiling mouth line; A's head has blocky croc-style tiles and a chunky lower lip. Body and legs are the same. / A's long-necked creature has round scales and a clear lip line with the eye set in the head; B has blocky cobbled skin, a boxy jaw and eyes that bulge like googly eyes.

A has banded segments on tail and legs and a grinning toothed mouth on the head; B is a smooth featureless tube body with no mouth. / B's scorpion has segment bands on the tail, legs and claw arms, and a mouth with tiny teeth, so it reads as an arthropod with a face; A is a smooth tube with no mouth.

A has tidy overlapping scales and a neat row of teeth along the jawline; B's cracked voronoi scales look noisy and its mouth is a dark hole with irregular star-shaped teeth. / B's eel-like creature has clean overlapping scales and a mouth with a row of teeth plus fangs; A's cracked-cell skin is noisy and its star-shaped teeth hang in a dark gap.

A's overlapping scales are clean, the mouth has a lip line with teeth, and the thighs taper from the hips; B has crackle-patterned skin, star-shaped teeth and straight stilt legs in the front view. / B's raptor has smooth scales and a clear mouth line along the jaw lined with teeth; A's cell-pattern skin looks faceted and its teeth are spiky stars with no real mouth.

B has a proper lip line with teeth along the jaw, a slit eye, and more shaped shoulder and haunch masses; A's teeth are star-shaped specks and the head is plainer. / A's bear has a clean mouth line along the jaw with a row of teeth and two fangs; B shows only a few star-shaped teeth with no lip line, so it looks pasted on.

B's head has a defined mouth line and smooth jaw, with spots covering the legs and tail; A has a jagged zigzag colour edge on the jaw and no visible mouth. / A's leopard has bold rosettes and a visible mouth line with a pale lip; B's spots are faint and the head has a jagged zig-zag edge between tan and cream fur, with no clear mouth.

B has a toothed mouth line, eyelid rims around the eyes and fine scales with small dots; A's face has croc tiles, big pale blotches and no readable mouth. / A's lizard has a clear mouth line with tiny teeth and neat scales; B has no readable mouth and a reticulated chin with blotchy camouflage and spots stuck on the head.

A has segmented abdomen and thorax lines and dark bands at the leg joints, so it reads as an ant; B is smooth and plain with a ragged jagged edge on the lower head. / B's ant has segment grooves on the abdomen and thorax and dark joint bands on the legs, so it reads as an insect; A is a smooth, flat red shell. B's seam lines are slightly rough at the waist.

A has a stitched grin line and eyelid brows on the eyes, so the face reads clearly; B's mouth is a ragged jagged smear and the eyes are bare bulbs. / B's goblin has eyelids, brow bumps and nostrils, and a stitched mouth line with teeth; A's head has a jagged sawtooth dark band where the mouth should be, and plain eyeballs.

A's scales are clean overlapping discs on the head and belly; B's cracked polygon skin looks noisy, and the belly shows crackle lines in the front view. / B's cobra has smooth overlapping scales on the head and hood and bands that stay clean; A's cracked-cell skin looks faceted and noisy, and its mouth and fangs are less clear.

Silhouette is identical, but A shows a mouth with small teeth under the snout and has cleaner skin; B has no readable mouth and its crackle pattern is noisier on the body. / Weak pick. The rhino's body and horns are identical, and B shows a faint mouth line and small teeth at the muzzle. A's polygon hide reads as armour but has no mouth, and B's disc scales look slightly pangolin-like.

B has a mouth line along the jaw with teeth and lidded red eyes; A's eyes are bare red balls and its teeth are star-shaped specks with no mouth line. / A's creature has a clear mouth line along the jaw with big fangs and small teeth, and its eyes sit in the head with a slit pupil; B has spiky star teeth with no mouth line, and its eyes look like bulging balls.
